p.src: 1  Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

en: Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.
u.src: 1  Then Jonah prayed to the LORD, his God, out of the fish’s belly.

p.src: 2  He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

en: He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.
u.src: 2  He said, “I called because of my affliction to the LORD. He answered me. Out of the belly of Sheol I cried. You heard my voice.

en: 2:2 Sheol is the place of the dead.

p.src: 3  For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

en: For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.
u.src: 3  For you threw me into the depths, in the heart of the seas. The flood was all around me. All your waves and your billows passed over me.

p.src: 4  I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

en: I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’
u.src: 4  I said, ‘I have been banished from your sight; yet I will look again toward your holy temple.’

p.src: 5  The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

en: The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.
u.src: 5  The waters surrounded me, even to the soul. The deep was around me. The weeds were wrapped around my head.

p.src: 6  I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.

en: I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.
u.src: 6  I went down to the bottoms of the mountains. The earth barred me in forever; yet you have brought my life up from the pit, LORD my God.

p.src: 7  “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

en: “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.
u.src: 7  “When my soul fainted within me, I remembered the LORD. My prayer came in to you, into your holy temple.

p.src: 8  Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

en: Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.
u.src: 8  Those who regard vain idols forsake their own mercy.

p.src: 9  But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”

en: But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”
u.src: 9  But I will sacrifice to you with the voice of thanksgiving. I will pay that which I have vowed. Salvation belongs to the LORD.”

p.src: 10  Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.

en: Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
u.src: 10  Then the LORD spoke to the fish, and it vomited out Jonah on the dry land.
